slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: The real problem usually appears after data has gone

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Businesses depend on Microsoft 365 for email, collaboration and file storage, but cloud storage alone doesn’t guarantee full data protection. A deleted mailbox, a lost SharePoint file or a ransomware attack can halt operations when there’s no dedicated recovery strategy.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Microsoft 365’s native features were never designed to replace a dedicated backup. We close that gap with reliable backup, proactive monitoring and fast recovery, built around how your teams actually work.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Backup sits alongside your Microsoft 365 tenancy covering Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams, with restores handled by us rather than left to you to work out. It is priced per user at a fixed monthly cost rather than bundled into rigid packages, so it scales with your team. Everything runs through the same UK service desk that handles your day-to-day tickets, so there is no separate team to chase.

slots.label: List item 1
slots.default: Reliance only on Microsoft’s native retention features

slots.label: List item 2
slots.default: Exchange Online mailboxes without dedicated backup

slots.label: List item 3
slots.default: SharePoint and Teams data that can’t be easily recovered

slots.label: List item 5
